items.title: Tech stocks today: AI warnings send shock through chip stocks

items.title: Elon Musk: I've been 'sounding the alarm' on AI for a while
items.summary: Leave it to Elon Musk to say, essentially, I've been right all along.

items.title: Anthropic, OpenAI now want to tame the rapid pace of AI development
items.summary: Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) CEO Dario Amodei and OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) CEO Sam Altman are in agreement that the AI industry needs to pace its development. Yahoo Finance's Jake Conley and Pras Subramanian are joined by Business Insider Today executive editor Dan DeFrancesco to discuss the two business leaders' latest statements and what these sentiments may ultimately mean for the AI frontier.

items.title: Wall St futures slip as rising oil, Treasury yields compound AI anxiety
items.summary: By Jayasree Prabhu Sept 15 (Reuters) - U.S. stock index futures slipped on Tuesday as higher crude oil prices, elevated Treasury yields and an uncertain outlook for AI demand kept investors at bay.

items.title: Bull of the Day: Caterpillar (CAT)
items.summary: Caterpillar offers investors a rare combination of industrial value, consistent earnings beats, and direct upside to the generational AI revolution.

items.title: Australia's AI Regulation Debate
items.summary: The global debate over AI safety is intensifying, as President Trump dismisses industry calls for a slowdown as a "conspiracy theory," and China brands fresh warnings about the tech "fearmongering." At the same time, Australia's cyber intelligence chief, Abigail Bradshaw, says the country needs an AI early warning system to guard against risks. Scientia Professor of AI at the University of New South Wales, Toby Walsh, joins "Bloomberg: The Asia Trade" to discuss the outlook for AI regulation in Australia.

items.title: Does VICI Properties' (VICI) Modest Dividend Hike Reveal Its True Capital Allocation Priorities?
items.summary: VICI Properties Inc. previously announced that its Board of Directors approved a regular quarterly cash dividend of US$0.46 per share for the July 1 to September 30, 2026 period, equal to US$1.84 per share on an annualized basis and payable on October 8, 2026 to shareholders of record on September 17, 2026. The 2.2% dividend increase offers a fresh data point on VICI Properties’ capital return priorities and cash flow capacity at a time when income-focused investors are closely assessing...

items.title: Microsoft Just Made a Move That Could Put More Pressure on Its Azure Business. Here's Why It Could Turn Out Great for the Stock
items.summary: The tech company will now report Azure's revenue in its quarterly results, not just its overall growth rate.
